Is your home in chaos, no matter how often you tidy up?

Do you feel stressed and frustrated?

Are you looking for support on your journey to creating a home that truly feels good?

Then you’re in the right place — welcome to Simplify Living!

I’m so glad you’re here!

Thank you for your interest.

You might wonder: Why would anyone make tidying up their profession?

Let me introduce myself and share why helping people create order brings me so much joy.

How it works

Using the KonMari® Method, I’ll guide you toward your personal vision of a calm and organized home. 

At the center of the process is you — your ideal home, and the small, practical steps that will take you there. 

The KonMari Method is built around one simple question: 

“Does it spark joy?”
